## Overview

Adyen's Android Mobile solutions hub introduces in-person payments on an Android mobile device such as a phone, either on the mobile device or with a card reader. The dated page names Tap to Pay on Android, Card reader on Android, and Android Payments app as its three solution routes. It is an overview and navigation entry, not a device, regional, merchant-eligibility, SDK/API, or payment-result specification. [[adyen]] [[adyen-mobile-pos]]

## Key takeaways

- The page groups the three Android Mobile solution paths under in-person payments. It does not describe their respective device requirements or how each path processes a transaction; follow the linked solution and build guides before selecting an integration. See pinned raw lines 15–23 and 57–61.
- System requirements, security and compliance, and getting-started/go-live checklists are separate linked guides. This page does not state a supported Android version, model, region, SDK version, account permission, security control, or go-live approval. See pinned raw lines 25–29 and 31–49.
- The page also routes to solution comparison, build, availability/software management, and mobile-device error handling. These are documentation routes, not evidence of a completed integration, deployment, or payment. See pinned raw lines 51–73.

## Detail locators

- **Android Mobile solutions** (pinned raw lines 15–29) — purpose, three named paths, and scope of the documentation.
- **Next steps** (pinned raw lines 31–73) — exact links to requirements, security, checklists, understanding the solutions, build, manage, and error handling.

* Tap to Pay on Android solution
* Card reader on Android solution
* Android Payments app solution
You can look up the system requirements, security considerations, and checklists for getting started and going live.

## Definition

Adyen's Mobile POS documentation covers in-person payment solutions using a merchant mobile device. The 2026-09-15 Android overview describes accepting payment on an Android device such as a phone, or using the mobile device with a card reader. It names Tap to Pay on Android, Card reader on Android, and Android Payments app as distinct Android solution routes. This hub does not itself establish the implementation or eligibility conditions for any route.

## Evidence boundary

The Android overview sends readers to separate requirements, security, checklist, build, management and error guides. It does not state device/OS or regional support, SDK/API versions, account eligibility, go-live approval, or successful payment execution. Keep this mobile-device route distinct from [[adyen-android-terminals]] (apps on Adyen payment terminals), [[adyen-android-sdk]] (native online checkout), and the device-specific [[adyen-mobile-card-readers]] concept. An iOS Mobile POS overview can contribute a separate source route after its own evidence review.
